title: What are Americans voting for in this election?
summary: The BBC's Maddie Gerber explains what's on the ballot in the 2026 midterm elections in the United States.

blocks.text: Americans are heading to the polls for the 2026 midterm elections on 3 November.
The BBC's Madeline Gerber explains what's on the ballot and what the outcome could mean for the balance of power in Washington.
